topStories.headline: US-Iran Ceasefire Collapses; US Launches Second Wave of Airstrikes on Iran
topStories.summary: Trump declared last month's interim ceasefire 'over' after Iran struck US bases in the Gulf and attacked commercial tankers in the Strait of Hormuz; the US launched a second wave of airstrikes to degrade Iran's maritime threat capability, with Trump signalling further strikes overnight.
topStories.marketImpact: WTI crude ↑ to ~$75/bbl (two-day surge exceeds 6%); Brent near $78–79/bbl; energy stocks ↑; global equities ↓; US 10Y yield ↑ to 4.58%; gold ↑ on safe-haven demand

topStories.headline: Fed September Rate Hike Probability Surges to 70% on Oil-Driven Inflation Threat
topStories.summary: After hawkish FOMC June minutes revealed a split committee — 9 members favouring at least one hike in 2026 — the oil price surge from the US-Iran escalation pushed September rate hike probability to ~70%, up from 58% the prior day, with Bank of America forecasting three 25bp hikes.
topStories.marketImpact: S&P 500 ↓ ~1.1%; Dow ↓ ~1.1%; TLT ↓; QQQ under pressure; financials watch for net interest margin benefit; stagflation risk re-emerges

topStories.headline: Samsung Q2 Profit Jumps 19-Fold to Record $58B — Stock Crashes 10%, Circuit Breaker Triggered
topStories.summary: Samsung Electronics posted Q2 operating profit of 89.4 trillion won ($58B) — a 19x year-on-year surge and the largest quarterly profit in tech history — but shares plunged more than 10% in Seoul, briefly triggering a circuit breaker, as the ~150% year-to-date run-up had priced in perfection and investors feared slowing AI capex.
topStories.marketImpact: Samsung (005930.KS) ↓ 10%+; Kospi circuit-breaker triggered; NVDA ↓; AMD ↓; broader AI semiconductor trade ↓ globally; open-source AI shift threatens hardware capex growth

topStories.headline: Nvidia Loses $1 Trillion in Market Cap Since May Peak, Down 17% From All-Time High
topStories.summary: Nvidia has shed roughly $1 trillion in market value in under two months since its May 14 ATH of $235, now trading at 21.7x forward earnings — the cheapest valuation since before the AI boom — as investors reassess AI infrastructure spending growth amid Samsung's shock, rising competition, and the open-source AI shift.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA ↓ 17% from ATH (rebounded +3.5% on July 8); AMD watch; SMH semiconductor ETF under pressure; hyperscaler capex commitment signal key for next leg

topStories.headline: Momenta Global Holds Gains on Day 2 After Successful $752M Hong Kong IPO Debut
topStories.summary: Chinese autonomous driving firm Momenta Global — backed by GM, Tencent, Mercedes-Benz, and BlackRock — rose ~3% on its July 8 trading debut at HK$301 vs. an offer price of HK$295.60, after raising HK$5.89 billion ($752M) with 14 cornerstone investors committing $376M.
topStories.marketImpact: Momenta HKEX ↑ watch for Day 2 stability; 0700.HK (Tencent) ↑ as major backer; GM ↑ watch for autonomous driving narrative; positive signal for China tech IPO pipeline

topStories.headline: Section 122 Tariff Cliff: Three Trade Deadlines Converge in 18 Days
topStories.summary: The 10% global Section 122 import surcharge — which survived a legal challenge after the Federal Circuit stayed a lower court strike-down — expires July 24 by operation of law; USTR is replacing it with 12.5% Section 301 duties on 46 countries, while USMCA Round 3 lands July 20 and USITC hearings concluded July 9.
topStories.marketImpact: Import-sensitive sectors ↑ watch as near-term tariff uncertainty peaks July 24; auto sector at intersection of Section 122, 301 and USMCA; EU goods locked at 15% under trade deal

topStories.headline: World Bank Cuts China 2026 Growth to 4.4%; Beijing Expands Offshore Yuan Trading Hub
topStories.summary: The World Bank revised China's 2026 GDP growth forecast to 4.4% (and 4.3% in 2027), both below the government's ~5% target, citing prolonged property sector contraction and subdued consumer demand; separately, Beijing and Hong Kong announced new measures expanding currency, bond, and gold trading to deepen the city's offshore yuan hub.
topStories.marketImpact: China property stocks ↓ watch; consumer discretionary ↓; Hang Seng cautious; offshore yuan trading ↑ — watch HKEX volumes and renminbi-denominated bond issuance

topStories.headline: Nikkei Extends Decline as Japan Wage Growth Fails to Lift Real Incomes
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 2.12% to 68,257, a three-week low, as the global chip rout and oil shock combined with weak domestic data — nominal wages rose 3.2% in May but household spending fell 0.4%, indicating real income pressure persists; Kioxia fell 11.3%, Taiyo Yuden 11%, Murata 10.1% in the prior session.
topStories.marketImpact: Nikkei 225 ↓ 2.1%; Topix ↓ 0.97%; Japan chip/component sector ↓; Bank of Japan wage-inflation watchpoint; yen weakening as oil import bill swells

topStories.headline: ADB Raises Asia 2026 Growth Forecast to 4.9% Despite Persistent Middle East Headwinds
topStories.summary: The Asian Development Bank upgraded Asia's 2026 growth forecast to 4.9% from 4.7%, citing resilient domestic demand, with Southeast Asia at 4.7% and Vietnam at 7.2%; the ADB warned that Middle East conflict continues to weigh on supply chains and energy costs, while India benefits from a 125bp cumulative rate cut cycle.
topStories.marketImpact: ASEAN equities ↑ watch; India infrastructure ↑; commodity-importing Asian economies pressured by oil spike; Vietnam and Philippines diverge on growth trajectory
